author: N6rL
content:
## Plan

### New file: alcanzai-core/src/vault_projection.rs

**VaultConfig** struct:
- vault_root: PathBuf
- note_subdir: Option<PathBuf>  (None → vault_root/Notes/)
- helpers: notes_dir(), watermark_path()

**VaultProjection** unit struct (derives Default):
- render_note(ko) → String  (pub, used directly in tests + bin)
- write_watermark / read_watermark  (dot-file in notes_dir)
- render_all(library, config, since: i64) — shared incremental logic
- impl Projection: render() reads watermark, calls render_all; rebuild() clears .md files + watermark then calls render_all(since=0)

**Note format (deterministic, no timestamps from wall clock)**:
- YAML frontmatter: alcanzai_id, title, authors (block seq), year (omit if None), content_type, doi (omit if None), arxiv_id (omit if None), source_plugin, fetched_at
- # Title heading (or # [Untitled])
- **Author et al.** • year (or n.d.)
- ## Abstract (if abstract_text is Some)
- ## Content (blocks sorted by sequence; skip Abstract/PageNumber/RunningHeader/Reference kinds; Heading → ##–#####; ListItem → bullet; FigureCaption/TableCaption → italics)
- ## Enrichments (per enricher: ### id + json code block + flags line)

**Private helpers**: yaml_dquote_escape, content_type_str, format_author_byline, render_blocks, render_block, now_unix_secs

### error.rs addition
Add ProjectionError::LibraryAccess(String) for Library → Projection error bridging.

### Cargo.toml addition
[dev-dependencies] tempfile = "3" (temp dirs for vault tests).

### lib.rs
Add pub mod vault_projection, re-export VaultConfig + VaultProjection.

### Tests (in vault_projection.rs)
1. render_note_frontmatter_keys — check YAML frontmatter keys and values
2. render_note_sections — abstract/content/enrichments appear when fields are populated
3. rebuild_empty_library_empty_dir — no .md files after rebuild on empty library
4. rebuild_idempotency — two consecutive rebuilds produce identical file contents
